question: Which bowler took the most batter dismissals (excluding run outs) in 2024?
sql: select d.bowler_id, p.name, count(*) as w from legal_deliveries d join matches m using (match_id) join players p on p.player_id = d.bowler_id where d.outcome = 'W' and m.season_year = 2024 group by all order by w desc limit 1

question: Which batter scored the most runs off legal balls in 2024?
sql: select d.batter_id, p.name, sum(d.runs_batter) as r from legal_deliveries d join matches m using (match_id) join players p on p.player_id = d.batter_id where m.season_year = 2024 group by all order by r desc limit 1
